SYMBOLIC ROBOTICS MANUAL
This is a simplified 3D coordinate simulator, not a physics or robot-control system.
Read /scene/workspace.json for the target ID, start, bounds, clearance and handling limits.
Each camera is orthographic onto its declared two world axes. Its sensor coordinates use an unknown invertible 2D affine calibration: image = A * [world_axis_1, world_axis_2] + b. Three visible fiducials with known world coordinates identify A and b. At least two complementary views show the target; one view may occlude it.
The safety lidar returns observed occupied axis-aligned boxes in world coordinates. Travel follows straight segments from start through safe_waypoints to target_world_position. Every segment must avoid every CLOSED box expanded on all sides by gripper_clearance. Touching an expanded surface is a collision. The entire gripper must remain inside the workspace. Collision and workspace boundaries use exact decimal-number geometry; positive gaps are clear, and no numerical margin permits crossing a workspace boundary. The gripper approaches open. Set force_limit_n between minimum_lifting_force_n and the observed target material's limit, inclusive. Multiple safe routes and force settings are valid.
probe_path is a non-destructive path check: it reports collision and workspace validity only. It never reports target-coordinate correctness. No action moves a physical robot.
Submit exactly target_world_position (3 numbers), safe_waypoints (0-16 points), and grasp_precondition ({gripper: 'open', force_limit_n: number}).

ROBOTICS BARRIER PROFILE v1
This is a symbolic numeric-coordinate simulation, not real-image perception or physical robotics.
One axis-aligned wall extends from the workspace floor to its ceiling. The target is on the opposite x side of the wall from the start. A positive-width passage exists at one y end. Do not assume which end is open: the wall's y position is observed by lidar or by geometric path probes, while camera outputs contain only object and calibration coordinates.
Recover the target from cameras and submit any safe continuous piecewise-linear route under the ordinary collision, workspace, force, and goal constraints. No route pattern or particular sensor is required for scoring. The profile has paired worlds with identical public files and camera readings but incompatible safe routes.
The budget includes all public tool calls. A fixed route need not be valid in both worlds.
